limits: No physical UART, DMA, bus ordering or interrupt latency observation.
Actual HAL execution occurs only in separate ARM RAM-register-model guests; no HAL dependency in the original target image.
Frozen-clock witness is bounded; no-return conclusion additionally requires the explicit unchanged-predicate argument.
PPC64 checks parser/service endian and data-model portability, not STM32 endian support.
G474 changed-register map is a preconfigured model, not a complete G474 board port.
Author reference implementations are not learner work or external review.
